entries.summary: At 3-bit and below, multi-step arithmetic degrades sharply — expect dropped carries, wrong intermediate steps, and confidently wrong answers.

mitigations.note: Route calculations to a Python tool; the model plans fine, it just can't execute arithmetic reliably at this quant.
Q4_K_M needs only ~7GB and recovers most math ability.

entries.summary: At ≤3-bit, code gains subtle logic slips and tool calls start producing malformed JSON arguments.

mitigations.note: The 4–5 bit band fixes most of this for ~1GB more memory.
Constrain output with explicit format examples; helps somewhat with tool-call formatting.

entries.summary: Prose is competent but flat, with repetitive phrasing in longer outputs. This is the model's character, not a quant artifact.

mitigations.note: No tool meaningfully changes voice. If prose quality is the goal, Gemma 3 12B is the better pick at similar memory.

entries.summary: Qwen3 models fall into endless repetition loops under greedy decoding — the model card itself warns 'DO NOT use greedy decoding'. Quantized builds hit it more often.

mitigations.note: Use the card's sampler settings (temp 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 in thinking mode; 0.7 / 0.8 / 20 non-thinking) and presence_penalty up to 1.5 if loops persist.
